snippet.title: Lost Rift Early Access Date Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
People Can Fly's upcoming survival shooter Lost Rift received a new trailer during the Future Games Show at gamescom. It's launching into early access on Steam this September 25.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #lostrift #gamescom
